meta.notes: A custom status effect, a good one (category beneficial) shown in the colour #c41c34. msm:on_tick fires msm_starter:ruby_rush_tick every 2 seconds (interval_ticks 40), more often at higher levels (faster_per_level: level II twice as often); its heal action gives the holder 1 half heart. Stat changes (attribute_modifiers): movement speed +20 per cent per level; they are removed when the effect ends. Its icon is textures/mob_effect/ruby_rush.png; paint over the placeholder to restyle it. Custom effects need the Fabric mod jar export.
